name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v7.1.10: Bugfix: PostToolUse domain-shift hook emitted invalid JSON (hand-rolled sed escaping corrupted strings containing quotes/unicode/newlines; CC silently dropped injections). Replaced emission with jq -n --arg (same safe pattern as pretooluse sibling). No floor bump. v7.1.9: Drop domain-shift --allowed-domains filter: server-confirmed domain_match anti-predicts relevance — cross-domain patterns are the more useful ones. Both domain-shift call sites now query by file-basename only (no domain token), pass --top-k 8, skip on empty basename. De-confounded bandit_rank ranks the unfiltered set. No floor bump (CC 2.1.163 / ace-cli 4.2.1 / @ace-sdk/core 3.2.2). v7.1.8: Server-blessed injection render refactor: bandit_rank best-first ordering, stop hard-dropping reward<0/isAtRisk patterns (0 drops / higher recall), tiered output (top-15 verbatim + compact ranked index), drop expanded cache-warming array, central ace_pattern_render.py helper wired into all 4 injection sites. -78% injection tokens on live prod. F-080 retrieval tracking preserved. No floor bump. v7.1.7: /ace:ace-graph polish: isolated/disconnected nodes hidden by default with "Show isolated nodes" toggle + header meta-bar showing connected/isolated counts. No floor bump. v7.1.6: Bugfix: /ace:ace-graph project-name resolution. No floor bump. ace-graph name lookup now matches on project_id/project_name (ace-cli 4.x schema); was matching id/name so the lookup never found a match and the graph title showed the raw prj_… ID instead of the human name. v7.1.5: Command de-stale + ACE-1.5 insights + new knowledge-graph command. No floor bump. ace-test de-staled to ACE-1.5 model (device-code auth, dynamic plugin root, ACE_PROJECT_ID env). .env.ACE_PROJECT_ID env-first in ace-clear/delta/export/import/learn (was legacy-first). ace-insights now logs/surfaces cumulative_v15_reward/isAtRisk/n_hot_pos/n_hot_eg. NEW /ace:ace-graph command renders local ACE knowledge-graph as interactive HTML (cytoscape, force-directed). v7.1.4: Concurrent-subagent degenerate-trace fix. No floor bump. Stage 1 — agent_id recovery from transcript path. Stage 2 — hygiene skip for fully anchorless SubagentStop traces. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution. v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
